text:
ana-cs: Quick preflight for Ellipsia private deploy today. Need green on network CIDR, KMS alias, IAM trust, and CloudTrail delivery. Window requested 11:00-12:30 PT.

mike-sre: Reviewing now. Customer VPC is 10.40.0.0/16. Planning inference subnet 10.40.4.0/24. Any overlap with their partner peering?

ravi-eng: They said partner peering uses 10.41.0.0/16, so looks clear. For IAM we'll create role redwood-ellipsia-infer-role with trust to acct 665544332211. Policy will restrict to sts:AssumeRole + s3:GetObject (models) and logs:PutLogEvents to their audit stream.

ana-cs: (typo) ana-cs: KMS: they want alias/ellipsia-prod, monthly rotation. Proposed CMK ARN posted in ticket. Need grants for redwood service principal and for their SIEM Firehose role.

ops-bot: Audit bucket s3://ellipsia-audit-prod created, CloudTrail delivery verified. Test object present.

mike-sre: I smoke-tested bucket write/read. Set lifecycle to 400d and blocked public access.

ana-cs: Who owns rotation runbook?

ravi-eng: I'll own the rotation runbook and PR to infra repo. ETA 90m.

mike-sre: I'll run a short canary (t0, t+10) with 50 requests and post p50/p95 and GPU util to #release-war-room.

ana-cs: Perfect. Start flip at 11:15 PT if infra green. Rollback plan: route traffic to redwood-small-fallback and revoke sessions.

ops-bot: Runbook item 5 (CloudTrail validation) marked DONE at 1801234610.

ana-cs: I'll capture customer feedback after the 75m monitor and file retro items. Tag me on blockers.
